channels.emailTestText:
🧪 Sentinel email test

If you received this email, your Resend push is configured correctly!

https://stock-monitor-nu.vercel.app/

Tip: ① Sign up at resend.com (free 100 emails/day) ② Get an API key ③ vercel env add RESEND_API_KEY + EMAIL_TO + EMAIL_FROM

④ For sandbox testing use EMAIL_FROM=onboarding@resend.dev (recipient must be your Resend account email)
channels.emailNotifLabel: Enable daily email delivery (in parallel with Telegram)
